body:
Who, Where, What Happened: 1. Pip the puppy (and Mom). 2. In the yard, in the rain. 3. Pip jumped in the puddle and got muddy. 4. Drawing shows Pip in a bath.
Retell The Little Seed: first, the seed fell in the dirt or the rain gave it a drink; next, the sun kept it warm; last, a sprout popped up. Drawing shows a sprout.
Retell a Story: 1. Her red mitten. 2. First under the slide, next by the big tree. 3. Drawing shows Rocky bringing the mitten. 4. Rocky found her mitten.
Scoring tip: "in order" means the three events are told first, next, last; extra details do not lower the score.
title: Answer key: Stories We Love
